Hi! We can do this. 

Look at the bottom numbers. We have 3 and 6. 

How do we get from 3 to 6? Do we multiply or divide? And what number do we use?
it is 4/6 because you multiply the top and bottom by 2 Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

Great job! You got it right. 

Now let us look at 2/9 + 4/9. 

Look at the bottom numbers. Are they the same? 

What do you think we do with the top numbers?
The bottom numbers are the same so we just add the top numbers 2 and 4 to get 6/9 Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

Spot on! 6/9 is right.

Now for 1/4 + 1/8. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are 4 and 8. Are they the same? 

Can you change the 4 into an 8? What do you multiply it by?
Um, is it 2/12? I just added the top numbers and the bottom numbers together, but I am really not sure about this.

That is a very common trick! But we do not add the bottom numbers. 

The bottoms must always be the same before we add. 

Look at 4 and 8. How do we change the 4 into an 8? What number do we multiply 4 by?
